messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: HIGH — Observability ingestion degraded in us-west-2. Logs and metrics are delayed; traces intermittently missing. Paging on-call.

Eve Morales: ack — i'm oncall and looking now. pulling Datadog status and our alert queue.

datadog-bot: Datadog Status: Investigating — Ingestion queues growing in us-west-2. Team triaging.

Maya Singh: seeing ~40-70m backlog for logs, metrics delayed ~15-40m. a few alerts show 'no-data' and some rate rules firing late.

Liam O'Neill: traced a gap in spans around 21:06-21:22 UTC, correlates with backlog growth. nothing in infra metrics showing app-side failures yet.

Eve Morales: opening ticket with Datadog — DD-542800. added account rep @dd_account. creating an internal incident doc and channel.

Eve Morales: mitigation plan from runbook: 1) enable local buffering on log-forwarders, 2) snapshot buffers to S3, 3) reroute critical alerts to CloudWatch, 4) mute noisy alerts. executing steps now.

Maya Singh: commands ready. apply buffering patch for forwarders and copy buffers to S3.

Eve Morales: ```
# enable buffering on forwarder daemonset
kubectl -n telemetry patch ds/log-forwarder -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"forwarder","env":[{"name":"BUFFER_MODE","value":"on"}]}}]}}}'
# tar buffer and upload to s3 for later backfill
tar -czf /tmp/forwarder-buffer-$(date +%s).tgz /var/log/forwarder/buffer && aws s3 cp /tmp/forwarder-buffer-*.tgz s3://redwood-backups/dd-ingest-fallback/
```

Liam O'Neill: muting noisy alerts for 45m: `./opsctl alerts mute --tag dd-ingest --duration 45m --reason "Datadog ingestion delay"`

Maya Singh: creating routing rule to send api_5xx and p95_latency to cloudwatch via internal router.

Maya Singh: ```
curl -X POST https://internal-router.redwood/api/v1/routes \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
 -d '{"from":"datadog","to":"cloudwatch","signals":["api_5xx","p95_latency"]}'
```

Jules Park (support): checking tickets — 4 customers reported transient errors in telemetry UI but no reports of functional service outages. customers seeing missing logs in dashboards. i'm drafting a customer-facing blurb.

Samir Patel: need status page update ASAP: indicate degraded observability in US-WEST-2 and that we're mitigating. i'll take copy.

Eve Morales: status redact: "Degraded observability: metrics/logs ingestion delayed in us-west-2. Engineering working with our provider. Fallback measures active; service functionality unaffected for most customers." posting now.

datadog-bot: Update at 1945000900: Teams have scaled ingestion workers; backlog processing has started. Estimated backfill ETA ~2 hours; monitoring for reorder.

Priya Kapoor: i'll take handoff in ~8 minutes. leaving checklist for next oncall: DD ticket DD-542800, local buffering + s3 backup completed, critical alerts rerouted to cloudwatch, low-sev alerts muted.

incident-bot: Handoff recorded: oncall -> Priya Kapoor at 1945001200

Priya Kapoor: ack — taking over. action items: continue muting noise, confirm S3 backfill plan (idempotency), and coordinate with DD rep for escalation if ETA slips >3h.

Maya Singh: i'll prepare a dry-run of backfill on a small buffer to validate dedupe logic and timestamp ordering before doing full backfill.

Maya Singh: ```
# dry-run backfill (small test file)
python tools/dd_backfill.py --source s3://redwood-backups/dd-ingest-fallback/test-buffer.tgz --dry-run
```

Liam O'Neill: watching for missed critical signals — cross-checking cloudwatch and app-side healthchecks to ensure we didn't miss a real outage.

Jenna Park (support): posted customer message to #customers-affected: "We are aware of delays with our monitoring provider in US-WEST-2 which may cause temporary gaps in logs and metrics. We have activated fallback paths and do not expect customer-facing service degradation. We'll share updates as we have them."

datadog-bot: Update at 1945002600: Backlog draining; ingest latency decreasing. There is some risk for high-cardinality metrics to be delayed longer. Next update in 30m.

Priya Kapoor: if Datadog ETA > 3h, escalate to account rep for possible ingest bypass or priority handling. @dd_account please advise SLA uplift options.

dd_account: acknowledged — i've flagged this to internal on-call at Datadog and asked for priority throughput. will update here as i get firm ETA.

Eve Morales: flag for postmortem: correlate the ingestion delay window with our 20:45 UTC deployment in prod and review whether it contributed to cardinality surge.

Maya Singh: agreed. will collect histograms for cardinality and cardinality-by-service during the window. also will save buffer manifests and S3 object list for post-incident artifacts.

Priya Kapoor: leaving channel open until we see sustained green and backfill complete. i've scheduled updates every 20m. if we detect customer-impacting regressions, paging will resume. thanks all for quick coordination. :white_check_mark:
